page.layout: One page of running text in the left column. A narrow column of marginal notes runs down the right margin. Page number at the top right. Running head at the top centre. A gathering signature "d" sits below the last line.

main_text.p: diligentiam adolescentes bonos: bene deniq; tibi collegusq; tuis consules.

Ad hunc ergo modum Ciceroniana ve-stigia fecuti fuasiones atque diffuasiones De ratione respondendi aliorum literis suasoriis, aut dissuasoriis. instituere poterimus: Restat vt quænā ad eiusmodi amicorum literas respondendi fit ratio tenenda; ostendamus. Est autem ea duplex. Vel enim amici cófilio acquie- Sententiæ in respondendo obseruandæ. scimus:vel illud ipsum reiicimus atq; im- probamus. Cum obtemperare volumus: sententiæ erunt adhibendæ laudatoriæ, gratias agentes,promittentes tum obedi- entiam, tum grati animi beneuolentiam & memoriâ perpetuam. Quod si verò da- tum improbare necesse confilium habue- rimus: laudabimus studium, fidem, & be- neuolentiam amici: rogabimus eundem, vt in partem optimam improbatione no- stram accipiat:rationes,ex caufis,& adiun ctis modestè adferemus,quibus adduƈti a- mici obtemperare confilio nó posfimus: quod scilicet illud, vel parum honestum, vel detrimentosum,vel difficile & pericu- losum:vel graue ac molestum: obstent te- pora: impediant personæ: fint loci, & cir- cumstantiæ quæ diuersum fuadeant.In ce- teris denique rebus nostram obedientiam pollicebimur. Tractatio verò ita est instituc- d

page.notes: Right margin notes are two short marginal headnotes, transcribed in place. The first is set in short lines: "De ratione re- / spondendi a- / liorum lite- / ris suasoriis, / aut dissuaso- / riis." Its wording is uncertain at the line breaks. "Ciceroniana ve-stigia": the hyphen after "ve" is faint and the word break is doubtful. The last word of the text is partly obscured at the gutter, so "instituc-" may be read differently. The running head and page number are clear. The signature is "d".
